description: TASK 2 — Add a client-side 'Clear chat' control to the SPA chat panel (spa/index.html + styles.css + app.js). Clicking it empties the #log container (removing all .msg nodes and any .pending refund box), clears/re-enables the input, and returns focus — leaving a clean ready-to-chat state. Vanilla JS, dependency-light, no backend call, no API/Lambda change. Independent of FEAT-001 (SPA files only; no CDK overlap).
steps: In spa/index.html, inside the existing `.chat-panel-header` div (which holds `#chatPanelTitle` and the `#closeChat` button), add BEFORE the close button: `<button type="button" id="clearChat" class="chat-clear" aria-label="Clear chat history">Clear chat</button>`.

In spa/styles.css, add a `.chat-clear` rule that fits the espresso header: transparent background, `color: var(--cream)`, `border: 0`, small `border-radius`, `cursor: pointer`, modest font-size (~13px) and padding, and a `.chat-clear:hover { background: rgba(247, 239, 230, 0.15); }` mirroring `.chat-close:hover`. Do not modify unrelated rules.

In spa/app.js, after the existing `const` element lookups add `const clearBtn = document.getElementById("clearChat");`. Add a guarded handler `if (clearBtn) { clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { ... }); }` that: sets `log.textContent = "";` (removes all rendered .msg nodes AND any .pending refund box — this is the entire conversation state because nothing is persisted), sets `messageInput.value = "";`, re-enables the input and the form submit if they were disabled, and calls `messageInput.focus();`.

Add a one-line comment in the handler noting there are no chat-history persistence keys to clear (no localStorage/sessionStorage is used), so the clear is DOM + input only, and that it makes NO /api call.
acceptance_criteria: The chat panel header renders a visible 'Clear chat' button left of the X close button, styled consistently with the header, with a working hover state and no layout shift of the title/close button.
Clicking 'Clear chat' empties #log (all .msg nodes and any pending-refund box removed), clears and re-enables #message, and moves focus to #message.
No network request fires on click (verified in the browser Network tab); app.js makes no new /api call and app/ Lambda code is unchanged.
Chat still functions after clearing: sending a new message appends to the now-empty log as before.
SPA stays dependency-light: no framework, no build step, no new files beyond the edits above.
verification: cd spa && python3 -m http.server 8099 >/tmp/spa-http.log 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; sleep 1; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8099/index.html | grep -q 'id="clearChat"' && echo button-present; kill $SERVER_PID

Manual browser check: open the served SPA, send messages (and/or trigger a pending-refund box), click 'Clear chat', confirm the log empties, the pending box is gone, the input is enabled and focused, no network call fires, and a subsequent message still works.
findings: Implemented client-side only, no backend/API/Lambda change. spa/index.html: added <button id="clearChat" class="chat-clear"> inside .chat-panel-header BEFORE #closeChat. spa/styles.css: added .chat-clear (transparent bg, color var(--cream), border 0, border-radius 8px, 13px font, 4px 10px padding, cursor pointer) + .chat-clear:hover mirroring .chat-close:hover (rgba(247,239,230,0.15)). spa/app.js: added const clearBtn = getElementById('clearChat') with the other lookups, plus a guarded click handler that sets log.textContent='' (drops all .msg nodes and any .pending refund box = full conversation state since nothing is persisted), clears messageInput.value, re-enables messageInput and the form's submit button if disabled, and focuses messageInput. The input is normally never disabled in current code; re-enabling is defensive. A comment documents that there are no localStorage/sessionStorage keys to clear and that no /api call is made. Verification: served spa/ via python3 http.server on 8099 and confirmed curl shows id="clearChat" (button-present). Manual browser Network-tab check not runnable headless, but the handler issues no fetch and chat keeps working because sendMessage() always appends into the same #log element. No new files, no framework, no build step. FEAT-001 (CDK custom domain) is independent and untouched.
